title: Multi-conformer molecules in solutions: an NMR-based DFT/MP2 conformational study of two glucopyranosides of a vitamin E model compound
abstract: Overall geometries of both glucosyl derivatives of PMC were found on the basis of their NMR spectra in CDCl                     3                     and related                     δ                     H,C                     /                     n                     J                     HH                     IEF-PCM(UFF,CHCl                     3                     )/DFT calculational results.
